# You are: The Next-Mover

**Your bundle: [pm-jobsearch](../../plugins/pm-jobsearch/)**

You are heading somewhere new. Read the job properly, reach the right person, walk in prepared.

## Your 3 starter skills

### 1. [jd-decoder](../../skills/jd-decoder/SKILL.md)

What a job ad really wants: the true must-haves versus the nice-to-haves.

```text
Decode this job description. What do they really want? ...
```

### 2. [outreach-message](../../skills/outreach-message/SKILL.md)

Short notes to recruiters and hiring managers that actually get replies.

```text
Write a short note to the hiring manager for this role: ...
```

### 3. [interview-prep](../../skills/interview-prep/SKILL.md)

Prep for one specific interview at one specific company, not interviews in general.

```text
Prep me for a product manager interview at a fintech next Tuesday.
```

## Install the bundle when you are ready

```bash
npx pm-claude-skills add --bundle pm-jobsearch
```

In Claude Code: `/plugin install pm-jobsearch@pm-claude-skills`
